item.createcrystallized.densite_core.too: A heavily compressed cube of Densite.
Whispers to you about kinetic _Stress Impact_ or _Capacity_. _Stressometers_ show statistics of their _attached kinetic network_. Some other blocks reveal information such as item and fluid content.
item.createcrystallized.creative_fluid_e: _DEV ITEM_ Removes liquid of one type in a large radius.
Removes fluid of _only that type_ in a large radius.
item.createcrystallized.creative_bag_of_: _DEV ITEM_ Changes states of _Machined Crystal Blocks_.
Changes the firing, charging, etc. state of _that_ block.
block.createcrystallized.oscillite_canno: Violent resonance in one convenient package, _not_ suitable for home defence.
When near a fully grown _Echo Crystal_
Arms itself when near an Echo Crystal. _Disarms_ when powered if the crystal fuel has been removed.
Redstone input discharges the cannon. Must cool down _without redstone power_ after firing.
block.createcrystallized.propulsite_thru: Powerful burst of propulsion with the power of crystals.
Begins to charge, _loses charge_ when not moving fast enough.
Becomes _energized_, Redstone input releases a powerful burst of thrust. must cool down _without Redstone power_ after firing.
Becomes _overcharged_, allowing for a _larger burst_ and _longer cooldown_ for every attached _Propulsite block_. Multiple thrusters share additional power equally.
block.createcrystallized.densite_well.to: A variable gravity well that _pulls in_ Simulated Contraptions.
Attracts Simulated Contraptions within its field. Radius and pull strength increase with _power supplied_.
createcrystallized.ponder.tag.machined_c: Blocks that enable crystal powered physics interactions.
createcrystallized.ponder.densite_well.t: Densite Wells generate a gravitational field when powered.
Use a redstone input to control the Well's power and range.
Physics assemblies inside the field are affected by the Well.
A low redstone signal creates a smaller field.
The weaker field slowly pulls nearby physics assemblies toward the Well.
Increasing the redstone signal strengthens and enlarges the field.
The stronger field quickly pulls nearby physics assemblies toward the Well.
